citations.assessment: The exilarch’s men see the black shoes, accuse the mourner of presumption, and imprison him.
Elazar invokes the living Shmuel and sitting court as authority. The exilarch’s men send the question to Shmuel, who confirms his ruling; no co-presence is stated.
A separate story about alternating requests for aggadah and halakhah.
Tosafot reports in the name of Eliezer Zeira. That establishes a textual route for Yuchasin’s claim, without establishing formal teacherhood.
The midrash has Abba bar Yamina speaking to Zeira. Keep both the speaker form and the discourse distinction.
The parallel supplies the aphorism attributed to Zeira, not a formal teacher–student statement.
